    def test_public_selected_routes_cover_shared_signature_callers(self):

        env={key:'' for key in os.environ if key.startswith('HEPTA_HIA_') and key.endswith('_MANIFEST')}

    def public_session(self, service, prefix):
        from tools.hia_agent_native_qualification import Session, ToolClient, add_program
        session=Session(ToolClient(service.call),prefix=prefix)
        session.freeze({'schema':'hepta.hia.agent.workload.v1','cases':[{'function':'transform','arguments':[0]}],
            'warmup_iterations':0,'repetitions':1})
        candidate=session.import_program(add_program())
        return session,candidate

    @staticmethod
    def forbidden(*args,**kwargs):
        raise AssertionError('selected emission called retained business policy')

    def poison_references(self, stack):
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(api.HIAAgentService,'_compile_reference',self.forbidden))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(api.HIAAgentService,'_hia_emit_reference',self.forbidden))
        stack.enter_context(patch.object(api,'_signatures',self.forbidden))

        if sum(bool(x) for x in (cold,compiler_choice,manifest_choice))!=1:
            raise ValueError('service emission requires one explicit cold, development compiler, or development manifest selection')

        if cold:
            cold=Path(cold).resolve();cold_bytes=cold.read_bytes()
            report=json.loads(cold_bytes,object_pairs_hook=builder._pairs)
            try:
                nested_path=Path(report['nested_report']);nested_bytes=nested_path.read_bytes()
                compiler=Path(json.loads(nested_bytes)['generations'][-1]['produced_image']).resolve()
            except (KeyError,IndexError,TypeError) as error:
                raise ValueError('service-emission cold report lacks a compiler') from error
            compiler_bytes=compiler.read_bytes();sources=builder.admit_cold_build(compiler_bytes,cold_bytes)
            if (type(report.get('qualification_wall_limit_seconds')) is not int or report['qualification_wall_limit_seconds']!=180
                    or type(report.get('cleanup_wall_limit_seconds')) is not int or report['cleanup_wall_limit_seconds']!=3
                    or any(sources.get(name)!=sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES)):
                raise ValueError('service-emission fixture requires complete original-limit current cold source')
            cls.inputs.update({str(cold):sha256(cold_bytes).hexdigest(),str(nested_path):sha256(nested_bytes).hexdigest(),str(compiler):sha256(compiler_bytes).hexdigest()})
        cls.temporary=None;evidence=os.environ.get('HEPTA_HIA_SERVICE_EMISSION_EVIDENCE')
        if evidence:
            base=Path(evidence);base.mkdir(mode=0o700,parents=True,exist_ok=True)
            cls.folder=base/cls.__name__;cls.folder.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        else:
            cls.temporary=tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-emission-native-');cls.folder=Path(cls.temporary.name)
        if cold:
            cls.manifest_path=builder.build(cls.folder/'current-cold-build',compiler,cold);mode='MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD'
        elif compiler_choice:
            compiler=Path(compiler_choice).resolve();cls.manifest_path=builder.build_development(cls.folder/'development-build',compiler)

        raw=cls.manifest_path.read_bytes();record=json.loads(raw,object_pairs_hook=builder._pairs)
        cls.image=native.installed_emission(cls.manifest_path)
        cls.inputs.update({str(cls.manifest_path):sha256(raw).hexdigest(),str(cls.manifest_path.parent/record['image_path']):record['image_sha256']})
        cls.inputs.update({str(ROOT/name):sha256((ROOT/name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES})
        cls.entries={};cls.original_entry=cls.image._entry
        def counted(source,size,output,capacity,work,extent):
            result=cls.original_entry(source,size,output,capacity,work,extent)
            raw=ctypes.string_at(source,size)
            if size==64 and int.from_bytes(raw[:8],'little')==native.REQUEST_MAGIC:
                mode=str(int.from_bytes(raw[48:56],'little'));cls.entries[mode]=cls.entries.get(mode,0)+1
            return result
        cls.image._entry=counted
        (cls.folder/'fixture.json').write_text(json.dumps({'mode':mode,'inputs':cls.inputs,'manifest_path':str(cls.manifest_path),
            'current_source_cold':bool(cold),'whole_stack_native':False},indent=2)+'\n')

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):

            if sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest()!=expected:raise AssertionError('held emission input changed: '+name)
        (cls.folder/'actual-entries.json').write_text(json.dumps(cls.entries,indent=2)+'\n')
        if cls.temporary is not None:cls.temporary.cleanup()

    def test_actual_proof_binds_held_emission_and_rejects_other_owner_after_restart(self):
        from hepta import hia_checker_identity as checker

        a=self.identity_files('A');b=self.identity_files('B-explicit-trailing-byte-mutant',suffix=b'\x90')
        rows=[]
        with self.independent_environment(a.manifest),patch.object(native,'SOURCE',a.source),ExitStack() as stack:
            self.poison_references(stack);service=api.HIAAgentService(a.case/'state')
            try:
                session,candidate=self.public_session(service,'held-emission-proof')
                held=service._native_emission.checker_owner()
                expected=checker.checker_native_selection(held_owners=(held,))
                for label,selection in [('original',str(a.manifest)),('different-image',str(b.manifest)),('cleared','')]:
                    os.environ[native.SELECTOR]=selection
                    build=session.emit(candidate,kind='object');result=session.encoding(candidate,build)
                    evidence=session.read_json(result['checks'][0]['evidence_artifact'])
                    self.assertEqual(evidence['native_checker_selection'],expected)
                    self.assertEqual(result['checks'][0]['checker']['native_selection_sha256'],digest(expected))
                    service._verification(result['verification_receipt'],session.context,candidate)
                    self.assertIs(service._native_emission.image,held.image)
                    rows.append({'selector_state':label,'held_identity':expected[native.SELECTOR],
                                 'real_emit_and_encoding_check':'proved'})
                with self.assertRaises(ValueError):
                    checker.checker_native_selection(held_owners=(evidence['native_checker_selection'][native.SELECTOR],))
            finally:service.close()
            os.environ[native.SELECTOR]=str(b.manifest)
            other=api.HIAAgentService(a.case/'state')

                    other._verification(result['verification_receipt'],session.context,candidate)

                restored._verification(result['verification_receipt'],session.context,candidate)
                self.assertIs(restored._native_emission.image,held.image)
            finally:restored.close()
        self.record('actual-held-proof-and-restart',{'observations':rows,'other_owner_rejected':'E_HIA_PROOF_SCOPE'})

        cls.temporary = None

        cls.entries = {}; cls.original_entry = cls.image._entry

            calls = []; frame = self.profile_frame(calls); issued = frame.pending
            fault = KeyboardInterrupt('actual verification ' + boundary)
            actual_entry = self.image._entry; injected = []
            def entry(source, size, output, capacity, work, extent):
                command = struct.unpack_from('<Q', ctypes.string_at(work, extent))[0]
                answer = actual_entry(source, size, output, capacity, work, extent)
                if work is frame.state and command == (2 if boundary == 'claim' else 1):
                    injected.append(command); raise fault
                return answer
            offset = next(item.offset for item in dis.get_instructions(native.VerificationFrame.service)
                          if item.opname == 'STORE_FAST' and item.argval == 'observed')
            def trace(pyframe, event, arg):
                if pyframe.f_code is native.VerificationFrame.service.__code__:
                    pyframe.f_trace_opcodes = True
                    if event == 'opcode' and pyframe.f_lasti == offset:
                        injected.append(offset); raise fault
                return trace
            try:
                if boundary == 'observed-store':
                    prior = sys.gettrace(); arming = sys._getframe()
                    old_trace, old_opcodes = arming.f_trace, arming.f_trace_opcodes
                    arming.f_trace = trace; arming.f_trace_opcodes = True
                    sys.settrace(trace)
                    try:
                        with self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught:
                            frame.service(issued)
                    finally:
                        sys.settrace(prior)
                        arming.f_trace, arming.f_trace_opcodes = old_trace, old_opcodes
                else:
                    with patch.object(self.image, '_entry', entry), self.assertRaises(KeyboardInterrupt) as caught:
                        frame.service(issued)
                        if boundary == 'ack':
                            frame.step()
                self.assertIs(caught.exception, fault)
                self.assertEqual(len(injected), 1)
                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 0 if boundary == 'claim' else 1)
                self.assertTrue(frame._uncertain)
                before = bytes(frame.state)
                with self.assertRaises((native.VerificationUnknown, RuntimeError)):
                    frame.service(issued)
                self.assertEqual(bytes(frame.state), before)
                self.assertEqual(len(calls), 0 if boundary == 'claim' else 1)
                rows.append({'boundary': boundary, 'positive_injections': injected, 'calls': len(calls),
                             'state_sha256': sha256(before).hexdigest(), 'state_prefix': list(struct.unpack_from('<42Q', before))})
            finally:

        self.record('actual-handoff-loss', rows)

    def test_independent_vm_complete_protocol_frames_all_eight_modes(self):
        from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
        from hepta.hia_program_runtime import _Machine, _Owner, _View
        checked = assemble_program(native.SOURCE.read_bytes())
        function = checked.as_dict()['functions'][0]
        rows = []
        for mode in range(1, 9):
            state = bytearray(self.image.workspace_bytes)
            output = bytearray(b'\xb7' * 2048)
            nonce = 7000 + mode; count = 0
            def call(command, flag=0, error=0, op=0):
                nonlocal count
                sequence = int.from_bytes(state[144:152], 'little')
                struct.pack_into('<6Q', state, 0, command, nonce, sequence,
                                 mode if command == 0 else op if command == 2 else flag, error, self.image.runtime_profile)
                raw = self.image.table
                src = ctypes.create_string_buffer(raw + b'\xa5' * 16, len(raw) + 16)
                out = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(output) + b'\xb7' * 16, len(output) + 16)
                work = ctypes.create_string_buffer(bytes(state) + b'\xc9' * 16, len(state) + 16)
                actual = self.image._entry(src, len(raw), out, len(output), work, len(state))
                owners = [_Owner(-1, bytearray(raw)), _Owner(-2, bytearray(output)), _Owner(-3, bytearray(state))]
                expected = _Machine(checked, 10000000, 16 << 20, None, 128).invoke(function,
                    [_View(owners[0], False), _View(owners[1], True), _View(owners[2], True)])[0]
                self.assertEqual(actual, expected)
                self.assertEqual(out.raw[:len(output)], bytes(owners[1].data))
                self.assertEqual(work.raw[:len(state)], bytes(owners[2].data))
                self.assertEqual(src.raw, raw + b'\xa5' * 16)
                self.assertEqual(out.raw[len(output):], b'\xb7' * 16)
                self.assertEqual(work.raw[len(state):], b'\xc9' * 16)
                output[:] = owners[1].data; state[:] = owners[2].data; count += 1
                return actual
            self.assertEqual(call(0), 1)
            self.assertEqual(call(2, op=int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little')), 4)
            # Protocol-only failed first observation. A generated try/except
            # may first request its match-type GLOBAL and EXCEPTION_MATCH;
            # this transport supplies a declared non-match flag. It does not
            # claim an actual provider or exception-matching observation.
            status = call(1, error=1)
            while status == 1:
                self.assertIn(int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little'), (2, 16, 21, 28))
                self.assertEqual(call(2, op=int.from_bytes(output[32:40], 'little')), 4)
                status = call(1)
                self.assertLess(count, 512)
            self.assertEqual(status, 3)
            status = call(4)

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parents[1]
CAPACITY = 16384
NONCE, OFFICIAL, PRIVATE, SCOPE, SCOPE_OWNER = (11, 17), (31, 37), (41, 43), (53, 59), (61, 67)
ABSENT = (0, b'')
ABI = b'{"f":{"params":["u64"],"returns":["u64"]}}'


def wire(value):
    return json.dumps(value, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':')).encode()


def text_field(value):
    return 1, value.encode()


def integer(value):
    return 3, str(value).encode()


def reference(seed, payload=None):
    return {'id': 'a-' + seed * 32, 'uri': 'hia://artifacts/' + ('f' if seed != 'f' else 'e') * 32,
            'sha256': sha256(seed.encode() if payload is None else payload).hexdigest()}


def reference_field(value):
    return 2, wire(value)


def packet(event, operation, *, sequence=0, token=0, fields=(), known=0,
           scope_kind=0, epoch=0, scope=(0, 0), callback=0, connection=OFFICIAL,
           nonce=NONCE, scope_owner=SCOPE_OWNER, shape=0, count=0):
    words = [REQUEST_MAGIC, event, sequence, token, *nonce, *OFFICIAL, *connection,
        scope_kind, epoch, *scope, callback, operation, known, len(fields), shape, count,
        *scope_owner, *([0] * 10)]
    return struct.pack('<32Q', *words) + b''.join(struct.pack('<2Q', tag, len(raw)) + raw for tag, raw in fields)


@lru_cache(maxsize=1)
def vm_program(source):
    from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
    return assemble_program(source)


class VM:
    def __init__(self):
        self.program = vm_program(SOURCE.read_bytes())
        self.entry = next(f for f in self.program.as_dict()['functions'] if f['name'] == 'f0')
        self.state = bytearray(CAPACITY)

    def call(self, raw, output_size=CAPACITY + 32):
        from hepta.hia_program_runtime import _Machine, _Owner, _View
        objects = [_Owner(-1, bytearray(raw)), _Owner(-2, bytearray(output_size)), _Owner(-3, self.state)]
        machine = _Machine(self.program, 100000000, 64 << 20, None, 128)
        count = machine.invoke(self.entry, [_View(objects[0], False), _View(objects[1], True),
                                          _View(objects[2], True)])[0]
        assert bytes(objects[0].data) == raw
        return count, bytes(objects[1].data[:count]), bytes(self.state)


class Machine:
    def __init__(self, image):
        self.image = image
        self.state = ctypes.create_string_buffer(CAPACITY + 16)
        ctypes.memset(ctypes.addressof(self.state) + CAPACITY, 0xb7, 16)

    def call(self, raw, output_size=CAPACITY + 32):
        source = ctypes.create_string_buffer(raw, len(raw))
        output = ctypes.create_string_buffer(output_size + 16)
        ctypes.memset(ctypes.addressof(output) + output_size, 0xa5, 16)
        count = self.image._entry(source, len(raw), output, output_size, self.state, CAPACITY)
        assert source.raw == raw
        assert output.raw[output_size:] == b'\xa5' * 16
        assert self.state.raw[CAPACITY:] == b'\xb7' * 16
        return count, output.raw[:count], self.state.raw[:CAPACITY]


class Protocol:
    """Controlled observations; never calls the production SQL/state bridge."""
    def __init__(self, engine, operation, *, slot='slot', expected=('0', '0'),
                 candidate=None, baseline=None, retained='0', lease=None, epoch=7):
        self.engine, self.operation, self.sequence = engine, operation, 0
        self.scope = {}
        if operation in (2, 3):
            self.scope = dict(scope_kind=2, epoch=epoch, scope=SCOPE, callback=71, connection=PRIVATE)
        elif operation in (4, 6):
            self.scope = dict(scope_kind=1, epoch=epoch, scope=SCOPE)
        fields = [ABSENT] * 11
        fields[0] = text_field(slot)
        shape = count = 0
        if operation in (2, 3, 7):
            fields[2:4] = [text_field(value) for value in expected]
            shape, count = 7, 2
        if operation in (2, 3):
            fields[1] = text_field('ctx-new')
        if operation == 2:
            fields[4], fields[5], fields[10] = reference_field(candidate), reference_field(baseline), (4, ABI)
        if operation == 3:
            fields[6] = text_field(retained)
        if operation in (5, 6):
            fields[0] = text_field(lease['slot'])
            fields[7:10] = text_field(lease['id']), text_field(lease['generation']), reference_field(lease['artifact'])
            shape, count = 31, 4
        self.observations = []
        self.send(0, fields=fields, shape=shape, count=count)

    def send(self, event, *, fields=(), known=0, token=0, **changes):
        raw = packet(event, self.operation, sequence=0 if event == 90 else self.sequence,
            fields=fields, known=known, token=token, **(self.scope | changes))
        count, returned, state = self.engine.call(raw)
        magic, status, sequence, extent = struct.unpack('<4Q', returned[:32])
        assert magic == RESULT_MAGIC and count == 32 + extent and returned[32:] == state[:extent]
        assert extent >= 4096, (status, extent)
        self.observations.append((raw, returned))
        self.sequence, self.status = sequence, status
        self.words, self.bytes = struct.unpack('<64Q', returned[32:544]), returned[32:]
        return self.words
    def outcome(self, fields=(), *, known=1):
        action, token = self.words[5:7]
        self.send(2, token=token)
        assert self.status == 0 and self.words[3:7] == (2, self.operation, action, token)
        return self.send(3, fields=fields, known=known, token=token)

    def slot(self, generation='1', epoch='1', *, present=True, context='ctx-old', abi=None):
        fields = tuple(text_field(v) for v in ('slot', context, generation, epoch, abi or sha256(ABI).hexdigest()))
        return self.outcome(fields if present else (), known=int(present))

    def snapshot_rows(self, ref, generation='1', epoch='1', *, count=0):
        self.slot(generation, epoch)
        assert self.words[5] == 2
        self.outcome((reference_field(ref),))
        assert self.words[5] == 3
        self.outcome((integer(count),))

    def hash(self):
        assert self.words[5] == 17
        return self.outcome((text_field(sha256(ABI).hexdigest()), integer(len(ABI))))

    def generations(self, values):
        assert self.words[5] == 5
        token = self.words[6]
        self.send(2, token=token)
        for value in values:
            self.send(3, fields=(text_field(value),), known=1, token=token)
            assert self.status == 0 and self.words[3] == 2
        return self.send(3, token=token)

    def write_version_and_slot(self, candidate, generation, epoch):
        assert self.words[5] == 8
        self.outcome((integer(1),))
        assert self.words[5] == 11
        self.outcome((reference_field(candidate),))
        assert self.words[5] == 9
        self.outcome((integer(1),))
        assert self.words[5] == 10
        self.slot(generation, epoch, context='ctx-new')
        assert self.status == 0 and self.words[3] == 3

    def lease_row(self, lease, active=1):
        return self.outcome((*[text_field(lease[key]) for key in ('id', 'slot', 'generation')],
                             reference_field(lease['artifact']), integer(active)))

    def commit(self, *, epoch=None):
        certificate = struct.pack('<12Q', *SCOPE_OWNER,
            self.scope['epoch'] if epoch is None else epoch, *SCOPE, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 101)
        return self.send(4, known=1, fields=((4, certificate),))


class DirectProtocol:
    """Independent opaque-handle observations, with no production bridge."""
    def __init__(self, engine, operation):
        self.engine, self.operation, self.sequence = engine, operation, 0
        self.scope = {} if operation in (8, 10) else dict(scope_kind=1, epoch=7, scope=SCOPE)
        self.send(0)

    def send(self, event, *, fields=(), known=0, token=0, **changes):
        raw = packet(event, self.operation, sequence=0 if event == 90 else self.sequence,
            fields=fields, known=known, token=token, **(self.scope | changes))
        count, returned, state = self.engine.call(raw)
        magic, self.status, self.sequence, extent = struct.unpack('<4Q', returned[:32])
        assert magic == RESULT_MAGIC and count == 32 + extent and extent == 4096
        assert returned[32:] == state[:extent]
        self.words, self.bytes = struct.unpack('<64Q', returned[32:544]), returned[32:]
        return self.words

    def outcome(self, *, predicate=None, entropy=None, void=False):
        action, token = self.words[5:7]
        old_live, consumed = self.words[21], self.words[45]
        self.send(2, token=token)
        assert self.status == 0 and self.words[3:7] == (2, self.operation, action, token)
        claimed = self.bytes
        self.send(2, token=token)
        assert self.status == 16 and self.bytes == claimed
        value = 0 if void else self.words[20] + 1 if predicate is None else int(predicate)
        result = self.send(3, known=1, token=token,
            fields=((4, struct.pack('<Q', value) if entropy is None else entropy),))
        expected_live = old_live ^ consumed
        if predicate is None and entropy is None and not void:
            expected_live |= 1 << (value - 1)
        assert self.words[21] == expected_live
        return result

    def commit(self):
        certificate = struct.pack('<12Q', *SCOPE_OWNER, 7, *SCOPE, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 0, 29)
        return self.send(4, known=1, fields=((4, certificate),))


def exercise_direct(test, make_engine):
    missing = DirectProtocol(make_engine(), 8)
    for expected in (100, 101):
        test.assertEqual(missing.words[5], expected); missing.outcome()
    missing.outcome(predicate=True)
    test.assertEqual((missing.status, missing.words[3], missing.words[40]), (0, 4, 1))
    lease = DirectProtocol(make_engine(), 11)
    predicates = {200: True, 202: True, 205: False, 209: False,
                  211: False, 215: False, 219: False, 224: False}
    actions = [v for v in range(200, 231) if v not in (212, 216, 220, 225)] + [241, 231]
    for action in actions:
        test.assertEqual(lease.words[5], action)
        if action in (215, 219, 224):
            test.assertEqual(lease.words[45], (1 << (lease.words[33] - 1)) | (1 << (lease.words[34] - 1)))
        lease.outcome(predicate=predicates.get(action), void=action in (241, 231))
    test.assertEqual((lease.status, lease.words[3], lease.words[40], lease.words[37]), (0, 3, 3, 1))
    before = lease.bytes
    lease.send(3, known=1, token=1, fields=((4, struct.pack('<Q', 1)),))
    test.assertEqual((lease.status, lease.bytes), (16, before))
    lease.commit(); test.assertEqual((lease.status, lease.words[3]), (0, 4))
    wrong = DirectProtocol(make_engine(), 10)
    wrong.outcome(predicate=False)
    test.assertEqual((wrong.status, wrong.words[3], wrong.words[36], wrong.words[37]), (11, 5, 1, 0))
    unknown = DirectProtocol(make_engine(), 8)
    token = unknown.words[6]; unknown.send(2, token=token)
    before = unknown.bytes
    unknown.send(3, known=1, token=token, fields=((4, struct.pack('<Q', 99)),))
    test.assertEqual((unknown.status, unknown.bytes), (16, before))
    unknown.send(5, known=1, token=token)
    test.assertEqual((unknown.status, unknown.words[3]), (22, 5))


def exercise_adoption(test, engine):
    baseline, candidate = reference('a'), reference('b')
    p = Protocol(engine, 2, candidate=candidate, baseline=baseline)
    p.slot(present=False); p.hash()

    previous = p.bytes
    p.send(3, known=1, token=1, fields=(integer(1),))
    test.assertEqual(p.status, 16); test.assertEqual(p.bytes, previous)

    def test_actual_direct_stateful_adaptation_and_comparison_order(self):
        events = []
        class Bind:
            def __init__(self, values):
                self.values = iter(values)
            def __conform__(self, protocol):
                self_protocol = protocol
                if self_protocol is not sqlite3.PrepareProtocol:
                    raise AssertionError('wrong SQLite adaptation protocol')
                value = next(self.values); events.append(('bind', value)); return value
        class Truth:
            def __init__(self, label): self.label = label
            def __bool__(self): events.append(('truth', self.label)); return False
        with self.selected():
            with patch.dict(os.environ, {SELECTOR: ''}):
                reference_service = self.service('adapt-reference')
            native_service = self.service('adapt-native')
            transcripts = []
            for service in (reference_service, native_service):
                ref = self.fixture_rows(service)
                service.store.db.execute("UPDATE main.slots SET name='first'")
                service.store.db.execute("UPDATE main.versions SET slot='second'")
                service.store.db.execute('INSERT INTO main.leases VALUES (?,?,?,?,1)',
                    ('count-only', 'third', '3', wire(ref).decode()))
                events.clear()
                target = Bind(['first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth'])
                with patch.object(service, '_native', return_value=(b'foreign', {}, None)):
                    lease = service.acquire_slot(target)
                self.assertIs(lease['slot'], target)
                self.assertEqual(events, [('bind', name) for name in ('first', 'second', 'third', 'fourth')])
                self.assertEqual(service.store.db.execute('SELECT slot FROM main.leases WHERE id=?',
                    (lease['id'],)).fetchone()[0], 'fourth')
                supplied = {'id': None, 'slot': 'wrong', 'generation': 'wrong', 'artifact': None}
                class Compared:
                    def __init__(self, label): self.label = label
                    def __ne__(self, other):
                        events.append(('compare', self.label))
                        if self.label == 'slot': supplied['generation'] = Compared('generation')
                        if self.label == 'generation': supplied['artifact'] = Compared('artifact')
                        return Truth(self.label)
                class Identifier:
                    def __conform__(self, protocol):
                        events.append(('bind-id', 'once'))
                        supplied['slot'] = Compared('slot')
                        return lease['id']
                supplied['id'] = Identifier()
                events.clear()
                retained = service._lease(supplied)
                self.assertEqual(retained, {**lease, 'slot': 'fourth'})
                expected = [('bind-id', 'once'), ('compare', 'slot'), ('truth', 'slot'),
                    ('compare', 'generation'), ('truth', 'generation'),
                    ('compare', 'artifact'), ('truth', 'artifact')]
                self.assertEqual(events, expected)
                transcripts.append(events.copy())
                self.assertTrue(service.release_slot(retained)['released'])
            self.assertEqual(transcripts[0], transcripts[1])
            (self.case / 'direct-foreign-order.json').write_text(json.dumps(transcripts, indent=2) + '\n')

    def test_actual_direct_foreign_exception_and_zero_row_release_match_original(self):
        from hepta.hia_agent_store import AgentRejected
        class RaisingId:
            def __init__(self, error): self.error = error
            def __conform__(self, protocol): raise self.error
        class RaisingComparison:
            def __init__(self, error): self.error = error
            def __ne__(self, other): raise self.error
        class RaisingTruth:
            def __init__(self, error): self.error = error
            def __bool__(self): raise self.error
        class Compared:
            def __init__(self, result): self.result = result
            def __ne__(self, other): return self.result
        with self.selected():
            with patch.dict(os.environ, {SELECTOR: ''}):
                reference_service = self.service('error-reference')
            native_service = self.service('error-native')
            observations = []
            for service in (reference_service, native_service):
                ref = self.fixture_rows(service)
                lease = {'id': 'retained', 'slot': 'slot', 'generation': '3', 'artifact': ref}
                service.store.db.execute('INSERT INTO main.leases VALUES (?,?,?,?,1)',
                    ('retained', 'slot', '3', wire(ref).decode()))
                for label, error, field, value in (
                    ('binding', ValueError('original binding error'), 'id', RaisingId),
                    ('comparison', TypeError('original comparison error'), 'slot', RaisingComparison),
                    ('truth', RuntimeError('original truth error'), 'slot', lambda e: Compared(RaisingTruth(e))),
                ):
                    supplied = {**lease, field: value(error)}
                    with self.assertRaises(type(error)) as raised:
                        service.release_slot(supplied)
                    self.assertIs(raised.exception, error)
                    self.assertFalse(service.store.db.in_transaction)
                    self.assertEqual(service.store.db.execute('SELECT active FROM main.leases').fetchone()[0], 1)
                    self.assertEqual(service._lease(lease), lease)
                # Registered adapters are consulted at each original execute.
                # The historical API returned released=True even if the second
                # binding selected no row. No extra caller binding is permitted.
                calls = []
                def adapt(value):
                    calls.append(value)
                    return value if len(calls) == 1 else 'no-such-row'
                key = (str, sqlite3.PrepareProtocol)
                original = sqlite3.adapters.get(key)
                sqlite3.register_adapter(str, adapt)
                try:
                    released = service.release_slot(lease)
                finally:
                    if original is None: sqlite3.adapters.pop(key, None)
                    else: sqlite3.adapters[key] = original
                self.assertEqual(calls, ['retained', 'retained'])
                self.assertEqual(released, {'released': True, 'generation': '3', 'artifact_retained': True})
                self.assertEqual(service.store.db.execute('SELECT active FROM main.leases').fetchone()[0], 1)
                self.assertTrue(service.release_slot(lease)['released'])
                observations.append({'bindings': calls, 'legacy_response': released, 'active_after_zero_row_update': 1})
            self.assertEqual(observations[0], observations[1])
            (self.case / 'direct-error-and-affinity.json').write_text(json.dumps(observations, indent=2) + '\n')

    def test_actual_machine_wrong_owner_corrupt_row_and_sequence_exhaustion(self):
        engine = Machine(self.image); p = Protocol(engine, 1)
        original = bytes(engine.state.raw)
        raw = packet(2, 1, sequence=p.sequence, token=p.words[6], nonce=(79, 83))
        count, returned, state = engine.call(raw)
        self.assertEqual((count, struct.unpack('<4Q', returned)), (32, (RESULT_MAGIC, 16, 0, 0)))
        self.assertEqual(engine.state.raw, original)
        # Reseal an otherwise valid independent state at its last u64 sequence.
        struct.pack_into('<Q', engine.state, 16, (1 << 64) - 1)
        data = bytearray(engine.state.raw[:CAPACITY]); value = 1469598103934665603
        words = struct.unpack('<64Q', data[:512])
        for word in words[:63]:
            value = (((value << 7) | (value >> 57)) & ((1 << 64) - 1)) ^ word
        for byte in data[512:words[55]]:
            value = (((value << 7) | (value >> 57)) & ((1 << 64) - 1)) ^ byte
        struct.pack_into('<Q', engine.state, 63 * 8, value)
        original = engine.state.raw
        raw = packet(2, 1, sequence=(1 << 64) - 1, token=p.words[6])
        count, returned, state = engine.call(raw)
        self.assertEqual(struct.unpack_from('<Q', returned, 8)[0], 18)
        self.assertEqual(engine.state.raw, original)
        corrupt = Protocol(Machine(self.image), 1)
        corrupt.slot('01', '1')
        self.assertEqual((corrupt.status, corrupt.words[3], corrupt.words[37]), (20, 6, 0))

                    'race-' + str(index), lambda *_: None)

            with ThreadPoolExecutor(2) as executor:

def write_json(path, value):
    path.write_text(json.dumps(value, indent=2, sort_keys=True, ensure_ascii=True) + "\n",
                    encoding="utf-8")


def file_identity(path):
    path = Path(path).resolve(strict=True)
    raw = path.read_bytes()
    return {"path": str(path), "sha256": sha256(raw).hexdigest(), "byte_length": len(raw)}


def source_map():
    from tools.hia_selfhost_contract import SOURCE_FILES, CONTRACT_PATH
    paths = set(SOURCE_FILES) | {CONTRACT_PATH, str(Path(__file__).relative_to(ROOT)),
        "tools/generate_hia_slot_ledger.py", "tools/build_hia_slot_ledger.py",
        "examples/hia_bootstrap/slot_ledger.hepta", "hepta/hia_slot_ledger_native.py",
        "tests/test_hia_slot_ledger_native.py"}
    return {name: sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in sorted(paths)}


def connection_rows(connection):
    orders = {"slots": "name", "versions": "slot,generation", "leases": "id",
              "requests": "key", "artifacts": "id", "costs": "sequence",
              "contexts": "id", "execution_budgets": "context_id"}
    return {table: [list(row) for row in connection.execute(
        "SELECT * FROM " + table + " ORDER BY " + order)] for table, order in orders.items()}


def database_rows(service):
    return connection_rows(service.store.db)


def persisted_rows(path):
    connection = sqlite3.connect(Path(path).resolve().as_uri() + "?mode=ro", uri=True)
    try:
        return connection_rows(connection)
    finally:
        connection.close()


def state_rows(service):
    all_rows = database_rows(service)
    return {name: all_rows[name] for name in ("slots", "versions", "leases", "artifacts")}


def suite_ids(suite):
    result = []
    for item in suite:
        result.extend(suite_ids(item) if isinstance(item, unittest.TestSuite) else [item.id()])
    return result


class RecordingResult(unittest.TextTestResult):
    def __init__(self, *args, **kwargs):
        super().__init__(*args, **kwargs)
        self.executed_ids = []

    def startTest(self, test):
        self.executed_ids.append(test.id())
        super().startTest(test)

        original = NativeSlotLedger.transition
        mapping_identities = {}
        def observed(image, request, state=None):
            captured = bytes(request)
            previous = bytes(state) if state is not None else None
            if id(image) not in mapping_identities:
                mapping_identities[id(image)] = sha256(bytes(image._mapping)).hexdigest()
            identity = mapping_identities[id(image)]
            record = {"request_hex": captured.hex(), "image_sha256": identity,
                "thread": threading.get_ident(),
                "state_before_sha256": sha256(previous).hexdigest() if previous is not None else None,
                "state_before_length": len(previous) if previous is not None else None}
            try:
                receipt = original(image, request, state)
            except BaseException as error:
                record["raised"] = {"type": type(error).__name__, "message": str(error)}
                self.transitions.append(record)
                raise
            following = bytes(state) if state is not None else None
            record.update({"status": receipt.status, "action": receipt.action,
                "values": list(receipt.values), "fields_hex": [value.hex() for value in receipt.fields],
                "raw_output_hex": receipt.raw.hex(),
                "state_after_sha256": sha256(following).hexdigest() if following is not None else None,
                "state_after_length": len(following) if following is not None else None})
            self.transitions.append(record)
            return receipt
        self.stack.enter_context(patch.object(NativeSlotLedger, "transition", observed))

        write_json(self.root / "observations.json", self.observations)

    def pair(self, service, session, *, same=False):
        case = AgentToolCase()
        case.service, case.session = service, session
        document = add_program(optimized=True) if same else None
        base, candidate, baseline, built, receipts = AgentToolCase.build_pair(
            case, document=document, candidate=document)

        self.assertIn(evaluation["outcome"], ("improved", "unchanged"))
        self.assertTrue(evaluation["termination_confirmed"])
        self.assertTrue(evaluation["planned_workload_complete"])
        return {"base": base, "candidate": candidate, "baseline": baseline, "built": built,
                "receipts": receipts, "evaluation": evaluation}

            candidate_artifact=pair["built"]["native_artifact"],
            evaluation_receipt=pair["evaluation"]["evaluation_receipt"],
            verification_receipts=pair["receipts"])

        arguments = self.adopt_arguments(session, pair, slot, expected)
        response = service.call("hia_adopt", arguments)
        self.assertEqual(response["status"], "completed", response)
        return response, arguments

    def rollback(self, service, session, slot, expected, generation):
        arguments = session.arguments(target_slot=slot, expected_current=expected,
            retained_generation=generation, reason="independent native slot integration")
        response = service.call("hia_rollback", arguments)
        self.assertEqual(response["status"], "completed", response)
        return response, arguments

                self.assertEqual(service.store.db.execute(

                for label, value, expected in (

                    ("slot mismatch before stored decoder", {**deepcopy(old), "slot": "foreign-slot", "artifact": None}, "E_HIA_LEASE"),

        finally:

        self.assertEqual(state_rows(service), before_bad_lease)
        self.assertEqual(service.release_slot(old),

        self.assertEqual(service.inspect_slot("leased")["in_flight_leases"], 1)
        with self.assertRaises(AgentRejected) as raised:

        try:

    @contextmanager
    def commit_fault(self, service, committed):
        original = service.store.transaction
        calls = 0
        @contextmanager
        def transaction():
            nonlocal calls
            calls += 1
            target = calls == 2
            with original():
                yield
                if target and not committed:
                    # The real original context manager executes ROLLBACK.
                    raise sqlite3.OperationalError("slot effect commit acknowledgement lost")
            if target and committed:
                # The real original context manager has completed COMMIT.
                raise sqlite3.OperationalError("slot effect commit acknowledgement lost")
        with patch.object(service.store, "transaction", transaction):
            yield
        self.assertEqual(calls, 2, "reservation and effect must use the original two transactions")

    def child_script(self, purpose):
        # Both subprocess controls call the real service and real image.  Only
        # the original transaction boundary or post-effect checkpoint is held.
        script = r"""

from contextlib import contextmanager
from hashlib import sha256
from hepta.hia_agent_service import HIAAgentService
from hepta.hia_slot_ledger_native import NativeSlotLedger
from hepta.hia_agent_store import wire
REFERENCE = @REFERENCE@
def forbidden(*args, **kwargs):
    raise AssertionError("child entered retained slot policy")
for name in REFERENCE:
    setattr(HIAAgentService, name, forbidden)
mode, root, request_path, marker_path, native, *artifact_roots = sys.argv[1:]
if native == "True":
    HIAAgentService._reference_call = forbidden
request = json.loads(pathlib.Path(request_path).read_bytes())
frames = []
original_transition = NativeSlotLedger.transition
def observed(image, raw, state=None):
    receipt = original_transition(image, raw, state)
    frames.append({"request_hex": bytes(raw).hex(), "output_hex": receipt.raw.hex(),
        "fields_hex": [value.hex() for value in receipt.fields],
        "image_sha256": sha256(bytes(image._mapping)).hexdigest()})
    return receipt
NativeSlotLedger.transition = observed
service = HIAAgentService(root, artifact_roots=artifact_roots)
def checkpoint(value):
    record = {"mode": mode, "in_transaction": service.store.db.in_transaction,
        "value": value, "native_frames": frames,
        "artifact_roots": [str(path) for path in service.artifact_roots],
        "requests": [list(row) for row in service.store.db.execute("SELECT * FROM requests ORDER BY key")],

    def spawn_owned(self, command, environment, prefix, *, input_pipe=False):
        write_json(prefix.with_suffix(".command.json"), {"command": command,
            "selected_images": {name: value for name, value in environment.items()
                if name.startswith("HEPTA_HIA_") and name.endswith("_MANIFEST")}})
        child = subprocess.Popen(command, cwd=ROOT, env=environment,
            stdin=subprocess.PIPE if input_pipe else None,
            stdout=subprocess.PIPE, stderr=subprocess.PIPE)
        child._slot_prefix, child._slot_consumed, child._slot_collected = prefix, b"", False
        self.addCleanup(self.cleanup_owned, child)
        return child

    def collect_owned(self, child, timeout):
        prefix = child._slot_prefix
        try:
            stdout, stderr = child.communicate(timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            prefix.with_suffix(".timeout.stdout").write_bytes(child._slot_consumed + (error.stdout or b""))
            prefix.with_suffix(".timeout.stderr").write_bytes(error.stderr or b"")
            write_json(prefix.with_suffix(".timeout.json"), {"timeout_seconds": timeout,
                "child_pid": child.pid, "native_result_not_confirmed": True})
            raise
        child._slot_collected = True
        prefix.with_suffix(".stdout").write_bytes(child._slot_consumed + stdout)
        prefix.with_suffix(".stderr").write_bytes(stderr)
        write_json(prefix.with_suffix(".process.json"), {"returncode": child.returncode,
            "child_pid": child.pid, "complete_output": True})
        return stdout, stderr

    def cleanup_owned(self, child):
        if child._slot_collected:
            return
        if child.poll() is None:
            child.kill()
        self.collect_owned(child, 5)

    def await_line(self, child, expected):
        ready, _, _ = select.select([child.stdout], [], [], 15)
        self.assertTrue(ready, "owned child did not reach original transaction checkpoint")
        line = child.stdout.readline()
        child._slot_consumed += line
        child._slot_prefix.with_suffix(".checkpoint.stdout").write_bytes(child._slot_consumed)
        self.assertEqual(line, expected, "owned child missed checkpoint")
        return line

    def preserve_table_comparison(self, label, before, after, artifact_directory):
        # Preserve complete original rows before any equality assertion.  A
        # newly issued artifact remains evidence even when that assertion fails.
        additions = []
        previous = before.get("artifacts", [])
        for row in after.get("artifacts", []):
            if row in previous:
                continue
            raw = (Path(artifact_directory) / row[1]).read_bytes()
            path = self.root / ("%s-added-artifact-%03d.bin" % (label, len(additions)))
            path.write_bytes(raw)
            additions.append({"row": list(row), "original_content": file_identity(path),
                "content_matches_row_sha256": sha256(raw).hexdigest() == row[1]})
        write_json(self.root / (label + "-tables.json"), {
            "before": before, "after": after, "added_artifacts": additions})

    def no_hosted_state_policy(self):

    def run_recorded(self, name, command, *, cwd=None, environment=None, raw_input=None, timeout=60):
        prefix = self.root / name
        write_json(prefix.with_suffix(".command.json"), {"command": [str(value) for value in command],
            "timeout_seconds": timeout, "cwd": str(cwd or self.root)})
        if raw_input is not None:
            prefix.with_suffix(".stdin").write_bytes(raw_input)
        try:
            result = subprocess.run(command, cwd=cwd or self.root, env=environment,
                input=raw_input, capture_output=True, timeout=timeout)
        except subprocess.TimeoutExpired as error:
            prefix.with_suffix(".stdout").write_bytes(error.stdout or b"")
            prefix.with_suffix(".stderr").write_bytes(error.stderr or b"")
            write_json(prefix.with_suffix(".process.json"), {"timed_out": True,
                "timeout_seconds": timeout, "complete_output": False})
            raise
        prefix.with_suffix(".stdout").write_bytes(result.stdout)
        prefix.with_suffix(".stderr").write_bytes(result.stderr)
        write_json(prefix.with_suffix(".process.json"), {
            "returncode": result.returncode, "timed_out": False, "complete_output": True})
        self.assertEqual(result.returncode, 0, result.stdout + result.stderr)
        return result

def init_wire(names, nonce=17, declared_count=None):
    n = len(names) if declared_count is None else declared_count
    raw = bytearray(struct.pack('<4Q', 0, nonce, n, len(names)-n))
    for i, name in enumerate(names):
        value = name.encode('utf-8', 'surrogatepass')
        raw += struct.pack('<2Q', i, len(value)) + value
    return bytes(raw)


def raw_call(native, wire, state, *, output_size=512, state_size=None):
    source = ctypes.create_string_buffer(wire+b'\x33'*16, len(wire)+16)
    output = ctypes.create_string_buffer(b'\x5a'*(output_size+16), output_size+16)
    before = source.raw
    code = native._entry(source, len(wire), output, output_size, state,
                         len(state) if state_size is None else state_size)
    assert source.raw == before
    assert output.raw[output_size:] == b'\x5a'*16
    return code, output.raw[:output_size]


def sealed_state(raw):
    """Independent test-only checksum, never runtime admission authority."""
    value = bytearray(raw)
    extent = struct.unpack_from('<Q', value, 64)[0]
    h = 14695981039346656037
    for i, b in enumerate(value[:extent]):
        if not 120 <= i < 128:
            h = ((h ^ b) * 1099511628211) & ((1 << 64)-1)
    struct.pack_into('<Q', value, 120, h)
    return bytes(value)


def vm_buffers(wires, state_size=1688, output_size=128):
    import ast
    from tools.generate_hia_source_admission import source_program
    from tools.hia_selfhost_bulk import Body
    from hepta.hia_agent_assembly import assemble_program
    from hepta.hia_program import execute_program
    body = Body(0)
    owners, views = [], []
    for size in (output_size, state_size):
        owner = body.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [body.const('usize', size)])
        owners.append(owner)
        views.append(body.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner]))
    results = []
    for wire in wires:
        owner = body.value('buffer', 'buffer.new', [body.const('usize', len(wire))])
        view = body.value('mutbuf', 'borrow.mut', [owner])
        for i, value in enumerate(wire):
            if value:
                body.effect('buffer.store', [view, body.const('usize', i), body.const('u8', value)])
        body.effect('loan.end', [view])
        read = body.value('readbuf', 'borrow.read', [owner])
        results.append(body.value('u32', 'call', [read, *views], {'function': 'f0'}))
        body.effect('loan.end', [read]); body.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    observed = []
    names = {node.name: 'f'+str(i) for i, node in enumerate(ast.parse(source_program()).body)}
    for view, size in zip(views, (output_size, state_size)):
        # Losslessly pack the complete buffers into u64 returns so the original
        # 256-item assembly list limit remains unchanged.
        assert size % 8 == 0
        observed.extend(body.value('u64', 'call', [view, body.const('u64', i)],
                                   {'function': names['get']}) for i in range(0, size, 8))
    for view in views: body.effect('loan.end', [view])
    for owner in owners: body.effect('owner.drop', [owner])
    source = ('hia-asm.v1 hepta.hia.program.v8 source_admission_vm\n'
              'fn observe() -> ('+','.join(['u32']*len(results)+['u64']*len(observed))+') '
              'effects(alloc,read,write,trap) entry(b0)\nblock b0()\n'+body.text()
              +'  ret('+','.join([*results, *observed])+')\nend\n'
              +SOURCE.read_text().split('\n', 1)[1])
    with patch.dict(os.environ, {key: '' for key in os.environ if key.startswith('HEPTA_HIA_')}):
        actual = execute_program(assemble_program(source), 'observe', [], max_steps=2_000_000)
    if actual['status'] != 'returned':
        raise AssertionError(actual)
    raw = b''.join(struct.pack('<Q', value) for value in actual['values'][len(wires):])
    return actual['values'][:len(wires)], raw, actual['steps']

    def test_every_transition_output_and_state_equal_original_HIA_machine(self):
        original = _fixture().reference
        optimized = image()
        rng = random.Random(0x821512)
        transitions = 0
        for trial in range(16):
            names = [rng.choice(('z', 'a', 'é', '中', '😀', '\udcff'))+str(rng.randrange(12))
                     for _ in range(trial+1)]
            payloads = {name: rng.randbytes(rng.randrange(1537)) for name in names}
            states = [ctypes.create_string_buffer(8192), ctypes.create_string_buffer(8192)]
            nonce = 0x765000+trial
            def compare(wire):
                nonlocal transitions
                left = raw_call(original, wire, states[0], output_size=2048)
                right = raw_call(optimized, wire, states[1], output_size=2048)
                self.assertEqual(right, left)
                self.assertEqual(states[1].raw, states[0].raw)
                transitions += 1
                return struct.unpack_from('<6Q', right[1]), right[1]
            reply, _ = compare(init_wire(names, nonce=nonce, declared_count=len(names)//2))
            self.assertEqual(reply[0:2], (0, 0)); sequence=0
            while True:
                reply, raw = compare(adapter.packet(1, nonce, sequence))
                if reply[1] == 2:
                    actual={}
                    for i in range(reply[4]):
                        handle=struct.unpack_from('<Q',raw,48+i*72)[0]

                    self.assertEqual(list(actual), sorted(payloads))
                    self.assertEqual(actual, {n:sha256(v).hexdigest() for n,v in payloads.items()})
                    break
                self.assertEqual(reply[0:2], (0, 1)); sequence=reply[3]
                compare(adapter.packet(2, nonce, sequence, payloads[names[reply[4]]]))
        (_fixture().folder/'optimized-transition-equivalence.json').write_text(json.dumps({
            'cases':16,'transitions':transitions,'all_output_and_state_bytes_equal':True,
            'original_image_sha256':original.image_sha256,'optimized_image_sha256':optimized.image_sha256,

def _freshness_controls(folder, image):
    from tools import hia_selfhost_contract as contract
    original = contract.file_digests
    real_open, real_sha = io.open, sha256
    evidence = folder / 'freshness'
    evidence.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    control_root = evidence / 'source'
    control_root.mkdir(mode=0o700)
    baseline = original(ROOT)
    for name, expected in baseline.items():
        raw = (ROOT / name).read_bytes()
        if real_sha(raw).hexdigest() != expected:
            raise AssertionError('source changed while copying freshness control inputs')
        path = control_root / name
        path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
        path.write_bytes(raw)
    compilation = _fixture().compilation
    report = {'scope': _fixture().scope + '_ORIGINAL_ELEVEN_FRESHNESS_CONTROLS',
              'python': sys.version, 'image_sha256': compilation['image_sha256'],
              'source_sha256': compilation['source_sha256'], 'controls': [],
              'original_control_report': 'retained prototype COMPARISON.json; immutable archive provenance documented',
              'original_control_report_sha256': 'b262f49e6bd309bf9cea2ffff8383705bb6f242420389880909dea1cad26c3f9',
              'native_stage_events_are_boundary_observations': True,
              'hex_fault_is_after_HIA_digest_ACK_boundary_not_internal_hex_failure': True,
              'current_source_cold': _fixture().cold is not None,
              'whole_cold': False, 'full': False, 'default': False, 'live': False, 'deletion': False,
              'original_limits_changed': False}
    before = original(control_root)
    expected_order = list(before)
    assert before == baseline
    count = len(before)
    assert count >= 3 and 'tests/__init__.py' in before
    def save():
        (evidence/'RESULT.json').write_text(json.dumps(report, indent=2)+'\n')
    save()

    def observe(native=False, *, read_error=None, close_error=None, hash_error=None, hex_error=None):
        events=[]; current=[None]; owner = image.create() if native else None
        class Stream:
            def __init__(self, file, name): self.file,self.name=file,name
            def __enter__(self): events.append(['enter',self.name]);self.file.__enter__();return self
            def read(self,*a,**kw):
                events.append(['read',self.name])
                if self.name==read_error: raise OSError(5,'injected read failure',self.name)
                return self.file.read(*a,**kw)
            def __exit__(self,*args):
                events.append(['close',self.name]);r=self.file.__exit__(*args)
                if self.name==close_error: raise OSError(5,'injected close failure',self.name)
                return r
        def opener(file,*args,**kwargs):
            name=Path(file).relative_to(control_root).as_posix()
            current[0]=name;events.append(['open',name])
            return Stream(real_open(file,*args,**kwargs),name)
        class Hash:
            def __init__(self,value,name):self.value,self.name=value,name
            def hexdigest(self):
                events.append(['hexdigest',self.name])
                if self.name==hex_error: raise ValueError('injected hexdigest failure')
                return self.value.hexdigest()
        def sha(raw):
            if native: raise AssertionError('selected native owner called original Python file hash')
            name=current[0];events.append(['sha256',name])
            if name==hash_error:raise ValueError('injected hash failure')
            return Hash(real_sha(raw),name)
        if native:
            actual_invoke = owner._invoke
            def invoke(wire):
                if int.from_bytes(wire[:8], 'little') == 2:
                    name = current[0]
                    events.append(['sha256', name])
                    if name == hash_error: raise ValueError('injected hash failure')
                    receipt = actual_invoke(wire)
                    events.append(['hexdigest', name])
                    if name == hex_error: raise ValueError('injected hexdigest failure')
                    return receipt
                return actual_invoke(wire)
            owner._invoke = invoke
        result=None;error=None; started=time.perf_counter()
        try:
            with patch.object(io,'open',opener), patch.object(contract,'sha256',sha):
                result = owner.run(control_root, contract.SOURCE_FILES) if native else original(control_root)
        except BaseException as exc:
            error={'class':type(exc).__qualname__,'args':repr(exc.args),
                   'errno':getattr(exc,'errno',None),'filename':getattr(exc,'filename',None),
                   'cause':None if exc.__cause__ is None else type(exc.__cause__).__qualname__,
                   'context':None if exc.__context__ is None else type(exc.__context__).__qualname__}
        row={'events':events,'result_items':None if result is None else list(result.items()),'error':error}
        custody = None
        if native:
            custody = owner.snapshot(); state=custody.pop('state')
            custody['state_sha256']=real_sha(state).hexdigest()
            if error:
                old=(owner.calls,owner.reads,state)
                try:owner.run(control_root,contract.SOURCE_FILES)
                except RuntimeError:pass
                else:raise AssertionError('failed single-use owner replayed')
                assert (owner.calls,owner.reads,owner.state.raw)==old
                assert not owner.complete
        return row, {'wall_seconds': time.perf_counter()-started, 'custody': custody}

    def paired(name, **kwargs):
        original_row,original_info=observe(**kwargs)
        native_row,native_info=observe(True,**kwargs)
        row={'name':name,'original':original_row,'native':native_row,
             'original_info':original_info,'native_info':native_info,'equal':original_row==native_row}
        report['controls'].append(row);save()
        assert original_row==native_row,name
        return original_row

    started=time.perf_counter()
    try:
        r=paired('all_current_sources_original_read_close_hash_order')
        assert r['error'] is None and len(r['events'])==6*count
        assert r['events']==[[event,name] for name in expected_order
                            for event in ('open','enter','read','close','sha256','hexdigest')]
        target=control_root/expected_order[0];raw=target.read_bytes();old=target.stat()
        try:
            target.write_bytes(raw+b'\n# development freshness witness\n')
            os.utime(target,ns=(old.st_atime_ns,old.st_mtime_ns))
            r=paired('changed_bytes_with_original_mtime')
            changed=dict(r['result_items'])
            assert changed[expected_order[0]]!=before[expected_order[0]]
            assert {n for n in changed if changed[n]!=before[n]}=={expected_order[0]}
        finally:
            target.write_bytes(raw);os.utime(target,ns=(old.st_atime_ns,old.st_mtime_ns))
        dynamic=control_root/'hepta'/'zz_development_fresh_witness.py'
        try:
            dynamic.write_bytes(b'# new fresh source input\n')
            r=paired('new_dynamic_python_file_observed')
            assert len(r['result_items'])==count+1 and 'hepta/zz_development_fresh_witness.py' in dict(r['result_items'])
        finally:dynamic.unlink()
        r=paired('removed_dynamic_python_file_not_cached');assert dict(r['result_items'])==before
        first,second=expected_order[:2];moved=[]
        try:
            for i,name in enumerate((first,second)):
                source=control_root/name;backup=evidence/f'native-control-original-missing-{i}'
                source.rename(backup);moved.append((source,backup))
            r=paired('two_missing_inputs_first_sorted_error')
            assert r['error']['class']=='FileNotFoundError' and r['events']==[['open',first]]
        finally:
            for source,backup in reversed(moved):backup.rename(source)
        name='tests/__init__.py';source=control_root/name;backup=evidence/'native-control-original-directory-input'
        source.rename(backup);source.mkdir()
        try:
            r=paired('regular_input_replaced_with_directory')
            assert r['error']['class']=='IsADirectoryError' and r['events'][-1]==['open',name]
        finally:source.rmdir();backup.rename(source)
        for label,key in [('read_failure_prefix','read_error'),('close_failure_prefix','close_error'),
                          ('hash_failure_prefix','hash_error'),('hexdigest_failure_prefix','hex_error')]:
            r=paired(label,**{key:second});assert r['error'] is not None
            assert not any(event==['open',expected_order[2]] for event in r['events'])
        source=control_root/second;backup=evidence/'native-control-original-later-missing';source.rename(backup)
        try:
            r=paired('earlier_hash_failure_precedes_later_missing_read',hash_error=first)
            assert r['error']['class']=='ValueError' and ['open',second] not in r['events']
        finally:backup.rename(source)
        assert original(control_root)==before and original(ROOT)==before
        report.update(status='PASS', source_before_after_equal=True, control_source_restored=True)
    except BaseException:
        report.update(status='FAIL', traceback=traceback.format_exc())
    finally:
        report['wall_seconds']=time.perf_counter()-started
        save()
        summary={k:v for k,v in report.items() if k!='controls'}
        summary['controls']=[{'name':r['name'],'equal':r['equal'],
            'original_error':r['original']['error'], 'native_info':r['native_info']} for r in report['controls']]
        summary['raw_report_bytes']=(evidence/'RESULT.json').stat().st_size
        summary['raw_report_sha256']=real_sha((evidence/'RESULT.json').read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        (evidence/'SUMMARY.json').write_text(json.dumps(summary,indent=2)+'\n')
        print(json.dumps(summary,indent=2))
    if report['status'] != 'PASS':
        raise AssertionError(report['traceback'])
    assert len(report['controls']) == 11
    return summary

    @classmethod

    def _compile_transport(self, *, mutate=None, collision=False):
        """Inject at the fixed compiler transport using actual retained bytes.

        This does not re-run a compiler or establish a new cold result. It
        checks this builder's refusal/publication boundaries independently.

        fixture = self.fixture

            self.assertEqual(label, 'source-admission')
            self.assertEqual(compiler.read_bytes(), fixture.snapshots[fixture.compiler])
            self.assertEqual(source, fixture.snapshots[SOURCE])
            image_path = output / (label + '.image.bin')
            image_path.write_bytes(image_bytes)
            receipt = dict(original, case=label, produced_image=str(image_path))
            if mutate:
                mutate(receipt)
            (output / (label + '.receipt.json')).write_bytes(_json_bytes(receipt))
            if collision:
                (output / 'development-manifest.json').write_bytes(b'previous publication')
            return image_path, receipt

class PublicationUnionCustodyTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def assert_closed(self, fd):
        with self.assertRaises(OSError) as caught:
            os.fstat(fd)
        self.assertEqual(caught.exception.errno, errno.EBADF)

    def test_actual_returned_process_keeps_structured_refusal_and_never_replays(self):
        import hepta.artifact_publication_native as native
        from hepta.artifact_publication import PublicationRejected
        from tests.test_hia_program_selfhost import _test_executable
        code = _test_executable(bytes.fromhex("b83c000000bf0c0000000f05"))
        original_run = subprocess.run
        for operation in native.NATIVE_PUBLICATION_OPERATIONS:
            observed = []
            def inspect_and_run(argv, **kwargs):
                fd = int(argv[0].rsplit("/", 1)[1])
                observed.append(fd)
                self.assertEqual(fcntl.fcntl(fd, 1034) & 15, 15)
                self.assertEqual(os.pread(fd, len(code) + 1, 0), code)
                self.assertEqual(kwargs["pass_fds"], (fd,))
                return original_run(argv, **kwargs)
            with self.subTest(operation=operation):
                with (patch.object(native, "_validated_code", return_value=code),
                      patch.object(native.subprocess, "run", side_effect=inspect_and_run) as run):
                    with self.assertRaises(native.NativePublicationRefusal) as caught:
                        native._execute_native("selected", operation, "stage", "dest", b"")
                    self.assertIsInstance(caught.exception, PublicationRejected)
                    self.assertEqual(caught.exception.operation, operation)
                    self.assertEqual(caught.exception.returncode, 12)
                    self.assertEqual(str(caught.exception), "E_PUBLISH_RACE: native " + operation
                                     + " refused or I/O failed; no automatic replay")
                    run.assert_called_once()
                self.assertEqual(len(observed), 1)
                self.assert_closed(observed[0])

        code = b"captured-executable-fixture"

        for changed in (code[:-1], bytes([code[0] ^ 1]) + code[1:]):
            descriptors = []
            def corrupt_real_write(fd, data):

                        native._execute_native("selected", "withdraw", "stage", "dest", b"")

@contextmanager
def controlled_build():
    with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-store-build-control-') as folder:
        root = Path(folder)
        for name in builder.DEVELOPMENT_INPUT_NAMES:
            path = root / name; path.parent.mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            path.write_bytes(('controlled input: ' + name).encode())

        compiler.write_bytes(b'controlled compiler, not executable')
        cold.write_text(json.dumps({'qualification_wall_limit_seconds': 180, 'cleanup_wall_limit_seconds': 3}))
        sources = {name: sha256((root / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES}
        output = root / 'output'
        calls = []
        def compile_stage(out, label, consumed_compiler, source):
            calls.append((out, label, consumed_compiler, source))
            image = out / (label + '.image.bin'); image.write_bytes(b'x')
            c, s, i = (sha256(raw).hexdigest() for raw in (compiler.read_bytes(), source, b'x'))
            receipt = {'status': 'returned', 'format': 'flat-x86-64',
                'return_encoding': 'zero-extended-u32', 'artifact_sha256': c, 'image_sha256': c,
                'input_sha256': s, 'source_sha256': s, 'produced_sha256': i,
                'input_bytes': len(source), 'produced_bytes': 1, 'result_u64': 1, 'core_u32': 1,
                'abi_status': 0, 'source_unchanged': True, 'forbidden_compiler_modules_loaded': [],
                'case': label, 'produced_image': str(image)}
            (out / (label + '.receipt.json')).write_text(json.dumps(receipt))
            return image, receipt
        with patch.object(builder, 'ROOT', root), patch.object(builder, 'admit_cold_build', return_value=sources), patch.object(builder, 'current_sources', return_value=sources):
            yield SimpleNamespace(root=root, compiler=compiler, cold=cold, sources=sources,
                                  output=output, calls=calls, compile_stage=compile_stage)

def _fields(value):
    if isinstance(value, ast.AST):
        return (type(value).__name__, tuple((key, _fields(item)) for key, item in ast.iter_fields(value)))
    if isinstance(value, list):
        return tuple(_fields(item) for item in value)
    return (type(value).__name__, value)


def _reference_methods():
    return ('_initialize_reference', '_close_reference')


def _reference_aliases():
    return ('_NATIVE_STORE_INITIALIZE_REFERENCE', '_NATIVE_STORE_CLOSE_REFERENCE')


def _clean_environment():
    return {key: value for key, value in os.environ.items() if not key.startswith('HEPTA_HIA_')}


class StoreLifecycleSourceTests(unittest.TestCase):
    def test_two_exact_original_bodies_preserve_sql_and_reference_definitions(self):
        original = json.loads(ORIGINAL.read_bytes())
        policy = next(node for node in ast.parse((ROOT / 'tools/hia_store_lifecycle_policy.py').read_bytes()).body
                      if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef))
        current = next(node for node in ast.parse((ROOT / 'hepta/hia_agent_store.py').read_bytes()).body
                       if isinstance(node, ast.ClassDef) and node.name == 'AgentStore')
        self.assertEqual(tuple(node.name for node in policy.body), ('__init__', 'close'))
        self.assertEqual(native.ARITIES, {'__init__': 2, 'close': 1})
        for name, reference in zip(('__init__', 'close'), _reference_methods()):
            row = original['methods'][name]
            self.assertEqual(sha256(row['source'].encode()).hexdigest(), row['sha256'])
            expected = ast.parse('class AgentStore:\n' + row['source']).body[0].body[0]
            authored = next(node for node in policy.body if node.name == name)
            retained = next(node for node in current.body if isinstance(node, ast.FunctionDef) and node.name == reference)
            retained.name = name
            self.assertEqual(_fields(authored), _fields(expected))
            self.assertEqual(_fields(retained), _fields(expected))

                         [('__init__', 'function'), ('close', 'function')])

        self.assertEqual(source().encode(), (ROOT / 'hepta/hia_store_lifecycle_foreign.py').read_bytes())
        namespace = ast.parse(source())
        table_sha = next(ast.literal_eval(node.value) for node in namespace.body
                         if isinstance(node, ast.Assign) and any(isinstance(target, ast.Name) and target.id == 'TABLE_SHA256' for target in node.targets))
        self.assertEqual(sha256(table(compiled)).hexdigest(), table_sha)

    def test_runtime_uses_fixed_effect_ports_without_original_policy_callbacks(self):
        for path in ('hepta/hia_store_lifecycle_native.py', 'hepta/hia_store_lifecycle_foreign.py'):
            tree = ast.parse((ROOT / path).read_bytes())
            for node in ast.walk(tree):
                if isinstance(node, ast.ImportFrom):
                    self.assertFalse((node.module or '').startswith(('tools', 'tests')))
                if isinstance(node, ast.Call) and isinstance(node.func, ast.Name):
                    self.assertNotIn(node.func.id, ('compile', 'exec', 'eval'))
                if isinstance(node, ast.Attribute):

class StoreLifecycleNativeTests(unittest.TestCase):
    @classmethod
    def setUpClass(cls):
        from tools import build_hia_store_lifecycle as builder
        cold = os.environ.get('HEPTA_HIA_STORE_LIFECYCLE_COLD_REPORT')
        compiler_choice = os.environ.get('HEPTA_HIA_STORE_LIFECYCLE_DEVELOPMENT_COMPILER')
        manifest_choice = os.environ.get('HEPTA_HIA_STORE_LIFECYCLE_DEVELOPMENT_MANIFEST')
        if sum(bool(value) for value in (cold, compiler_choice, manifest_choice)) != 1:
            raise ValueError('Store lifecycle requires one explicit cold, development compiler or development manifest')
        cls.inputs = {}
        cls.temporary = None
        evidence = os.environ.get('HEPTA_HIA_STORE_LIFECYCLE_EVIDENCE')
        if evidence:
            base = Path(evidence); base.mkdir(mode=0o700, parents=True, exist_ok=True)
            cls.folder = base / cls.__name__; cls.folder.mkdir(mode=0o700)
        else:
            cls.temporary = tempfile.TemporaryDirectory(prefix='hia-store-lifecycle-')
            cls.folder = Path(cls.temporary.name)
        if cold:
            cold = Path(cold).resolve(strict=True)
            outer = json.loads(cold.read_bytes(), object_pairs_hook=builder._pairs)
            nested_path = Path(outer['nested_report']).resolve(strict=True)
            nested_bytes = nested_path.read_bytes()
            if sha256(nested_bytes).hexdigest() != outer['nested_report_sha256']:
                raise ValueError('Store lifecycle cold nested report identity differs')
            nested = json.loads(nested_bytes, object_pairs_hook=builder._pairs)
            compiler = Path(nested['generations'][-1]['produced_image']).resolve(strict=True)
            cls.manifest_path = builder.build(cls.folder / 'current-cold-build', compiler, cold)
            mode = 'MATCHING_CURRENT_SOURCE_COLD'
            for path in (cold, nested_path, compiler):
                cls.inputs[str(path)] = sha256(path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        elif compiler_choice:
            compiler = Path(compiler_choice).resolve(strict=True)
            cls.manifest_path = builder.build_development(cls.folder / 'development-build', compiler)
            mode = 'EXPLICIT_COMPILER_DEVELOPMENT'
            cls.inputs[str(compiler)] = sha256(compiler.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        else:
            cls.manifest_path = Path(manifest_choice).resolve(strict=True)
            mode = 'EXPLICIT_MANIFEST_DEVELOPMENT'
        cls.image = native.installed_store_lifecycle(cls.manifest_path)
        record = json.loads(cls.manifest_path.read_bytes())
        cls.inputs[str(cls.manifest_path)] = sha256(cls.manifest_path.read_bytes()).hexdigest()
        cls.inputs[str(cls.manifest_path.parent / record['image_path'])] = record['image_sha256']
        cls.inputs.update({str(ROOT / name): sha256((ROOT / name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in builder.REQUIRED_SOURCE_NAMES})
        cls.record('fixture', {'mode': mode, 'manifest': str(cls.manifest_path), 'inputs': cls.inputs,
                              'python': sys.version, 'whole_native': False, 'production_default_changed': False})

    @classmethod
    def record(cls, name, value):
        with (cls.folder / (name + '.json')).open('x', encoding='utf-8') as stream:
            json.dump(value, stream, sort_keys=True, indent=2); stream.write('\n')

    @classmethod
    def tearDownClass(cls):
        after = {name: sha256(Path(name).read_bytes()).hexdigest() for name in cls.inputs}
        cls.record('source-and-input-after', after)
        cls.record('actual-image', {'image_sha256': cls.image.image_sha256,
                                  'native_frame_invocations': cls.image.entries,
                                  'opcode_counts': cls.image.observations})
        if after != cls.inputs:
            raise AssertionError('Store lifecycle source or actual inputs changed')
        if cls.temporary:
            cls.temporary.cleanup()
